# AI Storyteller

This folder is a small synthetic Vampire: The Masquerade vault used by the app's offline tests. Every note in it is invented test material for a fictional New York of 2001; nothing here is drawn from a published book or from a real play vault.

The frontmatter key `game: vtm` is the marker the app looks for when it decides which game a vault belongs to.

Notes the tests rely on:

- [[Core Mechanics]] (alias "Botch", section "Dice Basics")
- [[Hakim Olamaz]], [[Rene Valentine]] and [[Calebros]] under Characters/NPCs
- the Campaign 1 and Setting notes that the campaign1 profile loads as the chronicle bible
